title: Girl Night on Tour! An All-women Comedy Show at P'tit Ours
summary: An evening of all-women stand-up comedians comes to Montreal!
descriptionHtml:
An evening of all-women stand-up comedians comes to Montreal!

Fall in love with Girl Night!

Girl Night is an evening of live stand-up comedy featuring a lineup of all women comedians from all over Canada. This is your chance to see critically acclaimed acts and rising stars all wrapped up in a fun environment curated for women but enjoyed by all! Meet your hosts and BFFs Lindsay and Renee, see incredible comedy, then play the Secrets Auction where you bid for local prizes with your juicy secrets and confessions. This is THE girl's night out you've been looking for!
venueAddress: 5589 Avenue du Parc, Montréal, QC H2V 4H2

title: Girl-O-Ween! All-women Comedy Show and Halloween Party
summary: Your favorite all-women comedy showcase is throwing a Halloween party at Whoopsie Daisy Drinks!
descriptionHtml:
Your favorite all-women comedy showcase is throwing a Halloween party at Whoopsie Daisy Drinks!

Happy Girl-O-Ween!

This month, Girl Night is more than an all-women comedy show. We're throwing a delicious, bloody Halloween bash!

Wear your costume, eat candy, get a Tarot reading, and most importantly, enjoy 80's slasher music by the local band "Final Girl".

Come early to mingle, get pics with your girl group, dance and get your reading before the show starts!

Doors at 6:30 PM, music at 7 PM. Comedy show at 8 PM.
venueAddress: 1 Victoria Street South #Unit1, Kitchener, ON N2G 0B5
